name: Chroma-split glitch wall
looks: A word or image repeats full-bleed in horizontal bands, each band torn slightly out of alignment with the one above it, red/green/blue channels offset so every edge fringes with colour. It reads as a system glitching under pressure, not a stylistic filter.
build: The content is drawn three times in red, green and blue with alpha masking, each offset a few pixels differently per frame via kit.rng. The frame is sliced into 4-8 horizontal bands, each with an independent seeded x-jitter re-rolled every few frames rather than tweened.
sound: A harsh digital stutter or bitcrushed noise burst, cutting off sharply when the beat ends.
prompt: Punctuate an overload or error moment: repeat a word or image full-bleed in torn, misaligned horizontal bands with the colour channels split and fringing, held for less than a second, then cut hard out of it into calm.
source: an "Overthinking" motion study in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/gizakdag-cf4ae6), studied 2026-10-09
